extracted.intended_audience: PIOs / public information officers, press officers, and organizations submitting science news releases or multimedia to EurekAlert! (and journalists who use the platform)
extracted.subtask_description: Platform-specific eligibility and content rules for submitting news releases, multimedia releases, media advisories, feature stories, article highlights, and press summaries to the EurekAlert! distribution service. Covers what is acceptable, ineligible, and technical/formatting constraints (embargoes, licensing, AI content, multimedia limits).

rubrics_metrics.name: 90-day first-publication requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All news releases, multimedia releases, and media advisories submitted to EurekAlert! must describe information first made public within 90 days of content submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In cases of cited publications with online and print publication dates, EurekAlert! may consider whichever date is more recent. This requirement applies to news releases, multimedia releases, and media advisories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embargo policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Content may be submitted with a news embargo only if the embargo is set by the journal publisher or the organizer of a scientific meeting and/or press event where the information will first be publicly released.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content may not carry an embargo if the information is publicly available at the time of submission or is not related to a publication, meeting, or press event. EurekAlert! staff may request clarifications on embargo times and publication dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia must be cleared for third-party use
rubrics_metrics.description: All multimedia (images, videos, and audio) submitted to EurekAlert! must be cleared for third-party use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EurekAlert! does not accept multimedia sourced from paid or free stock image sites. For further details and a breakdown of accepted multimedia license types, consult the SciComm blog (linked). Exceptions and accepted license types explained in policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stock image multimedia ineligible
rubrics_metrics.description: Multimedia from stock image sites are ineligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This applies to both paid and free stock image sources; submitters should provide multimedia with transferable rights and third-party distribution clearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: EurekAlert! editorial/eligibility discretion
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! reserves the right to reject, re-categorize, or request additional clarifications on content submissions, including embargo times and publication dates, based on the eligibility guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff decisions can include re-categorization or requests for more information. Content eligibility guidelines may be updated without prior notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: No peer- or scientific review by EurekAlert!
rubrics_metrics.description: EurekAlert! and its staff does not produce or alter content submissions (except to meet site-wide formatting guidelines) or perform peer- or scientific review on information contained therein.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributing organizations are solely responsible for the accuracy of their content submissions; EurekAlert! and AAAS are not responsible for the accuracy of content posted or for the use of information through the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitter eligibility (PIO-membership & subscription)
rubrics_metrics.description: Only PIO-members with an active content submission subscription may submit eligible news releases, multimedia releases, media advisories, feature stories, and article highlights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press summaries are exclusive to organizations that host Press Packages in the reporter-only section. For hosting a journal Press Package or News Portal, contact business[AT]eurekalert[DOT]org.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Release: Peer-reviewed publications
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe information that has undergone validation by peer review are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include research studies published in a peer-reviewed journal; clinical trial results that have completed peer review; editorials, commentaries, or analyses that have undergone peer review and are published in a peer-reviewed journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Release: Reports and proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe information produced by a credible, recognized organization or through well-recognized scientific processes, but not intended for peer-reviewed publication, are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include research results presented at a recent/upcoming scientific meeting; editorials/commentaries not subject to peer review but published in a peer-reviewed journal; government or agency reports/white papers; advancement or conclusion of a clinical trial phase with preliminary results; scientifically validated survey or polling data/analysis; scientifically validated image analysis (satellite/telescope imagery); new databases or resources intended to aid scientific research and made available publicly or to the scientific community.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Release: Business announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases describing information that is primarily transactional in nature and/or not intended for further validation by peer review may be eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include collaborations, mergers, or agreements between organizations; start of a new clinical trial or calls for participation; regulatory approval, licensing, or patenting of new products/technology; forecasts/trends/new economic or financial developments in industries; developments from the scientific publishing industry; administrative or business announcements with societal or industry-wide impacts; science-related public awareness or educational campaigns; evidence-based policy announcements or recommendations; official position statements issued by a scientific organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Release: Meeting announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe timely information about scientific meetings are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible items include logistical or programmatic information about an upcoming meeting open to the media/public where new information is being presented, and summaries/highlights of recently held meetings that were open to the media/public.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Release: Grant and award announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe grant funding and awards are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include new or renewed grant funding, awards, or honors given to scientific organizations/projects/individuals (including fellowships) and calls for grant proposals, award nominations, or applications, particularly when noting societal or industry-wide significance.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Release: Book announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases that describe publication of a new science-related book, manual, or textbook are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book publication announcements follow the Book Announcements category and are treated as News Releases when eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Release definition and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: A multimedia release consists primarily of one or a collection of up to seven images, videos, and/or audio clips accompanied by an introduction and captions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multimedia releases may be submitted without a conventional news release narrative but must offer enough information for EurekAlert! staff to judge whether they meet eligibility criteria. To submit standalone multimedia, select the Multimedia Release category. Standalone multimedia can be added directly to the Multimedia Gallery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Advisory eligibility and audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Media advisories are made available only to journalist-members logged in to the EurekAlert! platform and must contain information that meets at least one specified criterion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria include: information about an upcoming physical or virtual press event or press-only components of a public event where new scientific research is being released; availability of one or more experts for press interviews; expert lists and Q&A transcripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature Story format & scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Feature Stories cover 'evergreen' science-related content and have a distinctive template separate from News Releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feature Stories are publicly accessible via search engines and the Features and Articles Portal, are not displayed through News Release feeds or distributed via email alerts, and examples include scientist profiles, overviews of research produced by an organization, updates or chronicles of research projects, Q&As/interviews, stories about initiatives or educational programs, and other storytelling-format science content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article Highlights scope & format
rubrics_metrics.description: Article Highlights describe peer-reviewed research studies published in a scholarly journal at any time and have a distinctive template.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Article Highlights are publicly accessible on the Features and Articles Portal and are not displayed through News Release feeds or distributed via email alerts. Organizations with dedicated news portals may opt to display Article Highlights in addition to News Releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Summaries access restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Press Summaries are brief synopses of peer-reviewed research studies and are only available to journalist-members while accessing the respective journal Press Package or News Portal on EurekAlert!.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press Summaries are exclusive to organizations that host Press Packages in the reporter-only section; contact EurekAlert! for more information about hosting press packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligible: research not yet peer-reviewed (preprints, working papers)
rubrics_metrics.description: News releases are ineligible if they contain research results undergoing — but have not yet completed — peer review, including working papers and preprints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions based on preliminary, non-peer-reviewed manuscripts are excluded from eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligible: opinion pieces lacking new peer-reviewed research
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorials, commentaries, op-eds, letters to the editor, or perspectives that are based primarily on individual opinion, not published in a peer-reviewed journal, or not supported by new peer-reviewed research or a recent review of existing research are ineligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opinion-format pieces without peer-reviewed backing or new/robust synthesis are excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ineligible: materials not in media release format
rubrics_metrics.description: Speeches, open letters, and other materials not written in a media release format are ineligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should follow the site-accepted media release templates and formats; otherwise they can be rejected as ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discretionary exclusion for perceived bias or advocacy
rubrics_metrics.description: In rare cases, at EurekAlert!'s sole discretion, news releases that may be perceived to promote biased findings, raise unanswered questions about potential conflicts of interest, and/or carry an advocacy agenda unfounded in scientific research may be deemed inappropriate for the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such discretionary decisions are rare and based on concerns about bias, conflicts of interest, or advocacy not grounded in scientific evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI-generated content policy
rubrics_metrics.description: AI-generated text, images and other multimedia are not eligible for submission and distribution on EurekAlert!.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exceptions may be granted in certain situations (e.g., for images/videos in research publications specifically about AI/machine learning). Exceptions evaluated case-by-case and must be disclosed at submission; documentation showing transferable rights to the AI-generated image/multimedia is required. Policy may evolve with copyright law and industry standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia submission mechanics
rubrics_metrics.description: Multimedia may be submitted on a standalone basis without an accompanying News Release to be added directly to the Multimedia Gallery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To submit standalone multimedia content, select the Multimedia Release category during submission. Multimedia Releases can include up to seven (7) images, videos and/or audio clips along with titles and a brief caption for each item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content update & legal disclaimers
rubrics_metrics.description: Content eligibility guidelines may be updated without prior notice and EurekAlert! disclaims responsibility for the accuracy of contributing institutions' content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributing organizations remain responsible for accuracy; EurekAlert! will only edit for site-wide formatting. See Terms & Conditions, DMCA, Privacy Policy, and other legal pages for details.
